name: source-origin-training-window-expansion-v5
selection: Measure the source-fitted starting checkpoint and each actual epoch. Validation gate/weakest margin before mean loss. Audit unused for selection.
optimizer_state: Not exported by original trainer. Fresh bounded AdamW continues the exact saved adapter, not a claimed optimizer resume.
training_layout: Symmetric verdict-first and verdict-last JSON/prose views, chosen by source hash. Bare training group remains unique.
training_expansion: At most 128 new non-overlapping windows from original training articles. Actual generator/byte/token/overlap refusals retained. Minimum 80 valid views.
bare_exposure: Four original article groups, eight origin pairs. Larger actual corpus must pass unchanged repetition gates and a worst-case negative reuse bound <= 0.10.
